content: This section describes how to **check if two code points are a valid escape**. The algorithm described here can be called explicitly with two [code points](INFRA#code-point), or can be called with the input stream itself. In the latter case, the two code points in question are the [current input code point](CSS-SYNTAX-3#current-input-code-point) and the [next input code point](CSS-SYNTAX-3#next-input-code-point), in that order.
